turn1.explanation: The unit responds to the faces of small furry mammals with pointed ears, mostly cats and foxes, extending to related mammals such as red pandas, lynx, hamsters, meerkats and ferrets.
turn1.evidence: 19 of the top 20 photos are cats, foxes, red pandas, lynx or small mustelids/rodents (1005–1527), plus one fluffy sheltie and one outlier vintage red car (#5). The most negative photos are mostly short-snouted or droopy-eared dogs (pugs, boxers, mastiffs), birds and hairless or short-haired animals, which suggests the unit contrasts furry, pointed-ear, small-faced animals against these.
turn1.missing_data: Activations on more dogs with pointed ears (e.g., huskies, shibas) and on non-animal red/orange objects would show whether the car is noise and where the line between cat-like and dog faces falls.
